title: Follow-Me
description: Per-drone configuration for the ADOS Follow-Me plugin.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the follow behavior is armed. Toggled by the Follow-Me Skill in the cockpit Skill Bar; the agent reads it live each loop.

follow_distance_m.title: Follow distance (m)
follow_distance_m.description: Standoff distance the drone trails the subject at, along the ground line of sight.

follow_height_m.title: Follow height (m)
follow_height_m.description: Height above the ground the drone holds while following: the downward rangefinder when it is valid, else the barometric height above the take-off point.

gimbal_point.title: Point gimbal at subject
gimbal_point.description: When a gimbal is present, point it at the subject. Ignored gracefully when no gimbal component is found.

designate_camera.title: Designate camera
designate_camera.description: The camera id whose detection stream the follow loop consumes and whose video the operator designates from.

camera_hfov_deg.title: Camera horizontal field of view (deg)
camera_hfov_deg.description: Horizontal field of view of the designate camera, used by the image-to-ground projection.

mount_pitch_deg.title: Camera mount pitch (deg)
mount_pitch_deg.description: Fixed downward tilt of the designate camera below the horizon, used by the image-to-ground projection. A forward camera needs a positive tilt to resolve a ground point; 90 is straight down.

reacquire_mode.title: Re-acquire mode
reacquire_mode.description: What happens when the lock on the subject is lost. strict: hold and wait for the operator to designate again. smart: coast on the prediction for reacquire_window_s and designate a person matching the subject's appearance and predicted position, announcing it on follow.reacquired.

reacquire_window_s.title: Re-acquire window (s)
reacquire_window_s.description: How long a smart re-acquire coasts on the prediction before giving the subject up.

reacquire_min_similarity.title: Re-acquire minimum similarity
reacquire_min_similarity.description: Appearance similarity (cosine, 0-1) a candidate needs to the subject's stored embedding to be re-acquired.

max_speed_mps.title: Maximum speed (m/s)
max_speed_mps.description: Cap on the velocity feed-forward sent to the pilot with each goal.

follow_mode.title: Mode
follow_mode.description: follow: hold a distance and an angle from the subject's travel heading. orbit: circle the subject at a radius and an angular rate.

follow_angle_deg.title: Follow angle (deg)
follow_angle_deg.description: Angle from the subject's travel heading the drone holds: 180 behind, 90 on its right, 270 on its left, 0 leading.

orbit_radius_m.title: Orbit radius (m)
orbit_radius_m.description: Radius of the circle flown around the subject in orbit mode.

orbit_rate_dps.title: Orbit rate (deg/s)
orbit_rate_dps.description: Angular rate around the subject in orbit mode.

orbit_direction.title: Orbit direction
orbit_direction.description: cw: clockwise seen from above. ccw: counter-clockwise.

obstacle_margin_m.title: Obstacle margin (m)
obstacle_margin_m.description: Clearance the pilot's planner keeps from obstacles while this skill flies.

detector.title: Detector model
detector.description: The detection model the follow loop consumes, bound to the shared vision detector. Lists every registered detection model, including the generic person model this plugin contributes.
